about.heading: Bruno & Maria's Team
about.body: We're the Trenton fence crew that walks every property before quoting. Maria handles estimates, Bruno oversees installation, and the whole team shows up ready to work.

reviews.name: Scott P.
reviews.text: Working with Maria and Bruno was easy and professional. Maria gave a rough estimate over the phone, then Bruno walked the property to confirm final pricing and layout.

reviews.name: Jessica C.
reviews.text: Bruno and his crew were wonderful to work with. When our pool finished early and we needed a safety gate fast, they handled everything perfectly.

reviews.name: Melissa M.
reviews.text: Maria and Jenny were fantastic — fast booking and great pricing. Bruno's installation team was professional and I'm so happy with the finished fence.
